_comment_do_not_ship_verbatim: Example panels only, per docs/upgrade-research/cache-cost-observability-2026-09-11.md Finding 3: no vendor surveyed (LiteLLM, Portkey, Langfuse, Helicone) ships a reference cache dashboard to copy from, and LiteLLM's own 3 maintained Grafana dashboards have zero cache panels despite LiteLLM itself supporting caching. PromQL below assumes the OTel-to-Prometheus exporter's default name translation (dot-namespaced instrument name -> underscored name, '_total' suffix on a Sum/monotonic counter) -- verify the exact translated names against your own configured collector/exporter before importing this dashboard; do not assume these strings are correct for every backend.
title: Kelvran Cache Observability (example)

panels.title: Cache hit rate by layer
panels.description: kelvran.cache.lookup, dimensioned by kelvran.cache.lookup_outcome (hit/miss) and kelvran.cache.layer (hit only). See docs/operations/TELEMETRY.md's 'Cache lookup hit/miss (metric)' row.

panels.title: Cache savings as % of LLM spend
panels.description: kelvran.cache.savings_usd (notional cost avoided, real since docs/rfcs/2026-09-10-gateway-cache-savings-metric.md) over kelvran.llm.spend_usd (real cost paid, added 2026-09-11 specifically to unblock this ratio -- it did not exist before). See docs/operations/TELEMETRY.md's 'LLM spend (metric)' row.

panels.title: Cache L3-lite gate rejection rate by gate
panels.description: kelvran.cache.l3.gate_outcome -- a per-gate ablation signal (which gate is doing the safety work). Reuses an already-shipped metric; no new instrumentation needed for this panel. See docs/operations/TELEMETRY.md's 'Cache L3-lite gate outcomes (metric)' row.
